requirements.requirement: The system must call the backend EVAL-P-TRIAGE API when a provider result requiring triage display is rendered in the chat flow.
The system must map API response fields to the frontend triage display schema defined in EVAL-P-TRIAGE-UX-S1 without loss of required data.
The system must render triage UI components from EVAL-P-TRIAGE-UX-S3 using the mapped data.
The system must display a loading state in the chat UI while awaiting the triage API response.
The system must replace the loading state with the triage display immediately upon successful API response.
The system must preserve message ordering in the chat flow when inserting the triage display response.
The system must handle empty API responses by displaying an explicit empty state message indicating no triage information is available.
The system must handle API errors by displaying a non-blocking error state within the chat UI.
The system must not crash or break the chat flow if the triage API request fails.
The system must support retrying the triage API call after a failed request via a user-triggered or automatic retry mechanism.
The system must validate that required triage fields (pass/fail status and specialty explanation) are present before rendering the UI.
The system must fallback to a partial display state when optional triage fields are missing but required fields are present.
The system must ensure that specialty match reasoning appears before quality-related reasoning in the rendered output.
The system must log API request failures and mapping errors for debugging without exposing internal errors to the user.
